title: Jersey Size Chart (2026)
verdict: A jersey size chart tells you the measurements of the garment, and every maker's chart is different. This page explains how to read one, how to measure a player, and shows an example chart from Wooter.
The short version: measure the chest, compare it to the chart for the exact product, and go up a size if the player wears layers or sits between two sizes.

p: Chart numbers describe the jersey, not the person. A jersey with a 44 inch chest fits a player whose chest is a few inches smaller, depending on how loose the sport wears it.
Sizes also shift by sport. A football jersey is cut to go over pads. A volleyball jersey is cut close. The same player can be a medium in one and a large in the other.

list: Chest: wrap the tape around the fullest part of the chest, level all the way round.
Waist: measure the narrowest part of the torso, above the line of the pants.
Hips: for women's or longer jerseys, measure the fullest part of the hips.
Sleeve: from the center back of the neck, over the shoulder and down to the wrist, with the arm bent.
Keep the tape snug, not tight. You should be able to slide one finger under it.

list: Basketball: loose and sleeveless. Most players wear their T-shirt size.
Football: sized to go over shoulder pads. Try one on with pads.
Baseball and softball: room for an undershirt. Size up if you layer.
Soccer: an athletic fit, closer than a T-shirt.
Volleyball: fitted. Check the women's or men's chart.
Compression and wrestling: tight by design. Use the chart, not your shirt size.
Choose the larger size for room and movement. Wooter's guide generally recommends sizing up.
Choose the smaller size only if you want a fitted look.
Size up if the player wears a compression shirt or other layers underneath.
Wash in cold water. Some fabrics shrink slightly.

why: Wooter publishes a size guide on every product and sells sizing kits, which are sample garments a team can try on before ordering. Jersey and shorts sizes are chosen separately for each player.
If you are unsure, order the sizing kit first. It costs far less than a team of jerseys in the wrong size.

faq.q: How do I know my jersey size?
faq.a: Measure your chest and compare it with the size chart for the specific jersey. Do not rely on your T-shirt size across sports.

faq.q: Do jerseys run big or small?
faq.a: It depends on the sport and maker. Football runs big to fit pads. Volleyball and soccer run closer.

faq.q: Are men's and women's jersey sizes the same?
faq.a: No. Women's cuts are shaped differently. Use the chart for the cut you are ordering.
A set of sample garments in each size that a team tries on before ordering.

faq.q: Can jersey and shorts be different sizes?
faq.a: Yes. At Wooter each player picks a jersey size and a shorts size separately.
